# SENSE

Screenshot translation for macOS. Select a region of the screen and the
translation is drawn over the original text, in the same position, size
and colour as the source, so nothing has to be copied or pasted.

Installation
------------

  * Download the latest build from the releases page and move SENSE.app
    into the Applications folder of your Mac.
  * Grant the screen recording permission the first time you use it.

    $ ./tools/install-app.sh
    $ open /Applications/SENSE.app

Name        Value     Notes
timeout     30        seconds, per request
retries     3         before giving up

The key never leaves the system keychain: requests are made by the app
itself and the web view only ever sees a masked copy of it.
